website.resolution: Build and integrate the local application-scanner core and add-ons, then rerun the authorized site scan.

website.message: JavaScript-rendered routes and forms were not inventoried.
website.resolution: Choose Full scan and configure the local browser runtime, then rerun scoped page discovery.

website.message: Signup, login, password reset, and role-specific journeys were not tested.
website.resolution: Provide controlled test accounts through environment variables and an authorized journey JSON file, then rerun those flows.

website.message: An API contract was not compared with observed traffic.
website.resolution: Supply a local OpenAPI JSON or YAML file for this website; add controlled authenticated journeys to observe protected routes.

website.message: The HTTPS certificate and negotiated TLS connection were not inspected.
website.resolution: Scan the HTTPS origin and ensure its certificate is accessible.

website.message: Older TLS protocols and accepted cipher suites were not enumerated.
website.resolution: Choose Full scan for an authorized HTTPS endpoint with the local Nmap NSE script ready.

website.message: Accessibility checks were not run on rendered pages.
website.resolution: Build the local accessibility script and run Full scan.

website.message: Performance and Lighthouse quality checks were not run.
website.resolution: Build the local performance adapter and rerun the page-level assessment.

code.message: Dependency and lockfile vulnerabilities were not assessed.
code.resolution: Build the local dependency-risk scanner and rerun the source assessment.

not_assessed_resolutions.stopped: The scan was stopped before this step ran. Start a new scan of this target to run it.
not_assessed_resolutions.full_profile: This check runs only in Full scope. Choose Full scope for a target you are authorized to test, then rescan.
not_assessed_resolutions.unfinished: This step ran but did not complete. Review its stage details and the related limitations, then rescan.

429.message: The target answered {count} request(s) with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests; checks after throttling may be incomplete.
429.resolution: Lower the template request rate or crawl scope in Full scan settings, or ask the site owner to allowlist this machine, then rescan.

403.message: The target answered {count} request(s) with HTTP 403 Forbidden; those responses were not assessed as normal pages.
403.resolution: If a firewall or bot protection blocks this machine, ask the site owner to allowlist it; for protected areas, add an authenticated journey, then rescan.

503.message: The target answered {count} request(s) with HTTP 503 Service Unavailable, which can mean overload or bot protection.
503.resolution: Rescan when the site is stable or with lower request rates, and ask the site owner whether protection is blocking this machine.

deep_profile_limits.message: Out-of-band template checks were excluded from this local profile.
deep_profile_limits.resolution: Configure a reachable callback service and an explicit OOB-enabled profile before rerunning those checks.

deep_profile_limits.message: Templates tagged dos, fuzz, or bruteforce were excluded.
deep_profile_limits.resolution: Review those template families and select a separate authorized test profile if they are required.
